analysis.pricePattern: Higher Low 형성 후 회복 시도

analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 5일 연속 관망 유지했으나, 금일 RSI 54.8 → 62.8으로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 -0.0003 → -0.0002로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호. 5일 고가 갱신으로 상승 추세 지속 가능성 확인.
analysis.reasonEn: After maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 5 sessions following the previous buy signal, today confirmed an exit from the oversold zone with RSI moving from 54.8 to 62.8. The MACD histogram also improved from -0.0003 to -0.0002, signaling a bottoming process. A new 5-day high was achieved, indicating potential continuation of the uptrend.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0003 → -0.0002): 음수 구간에서 개선되며 약세 약화 신호

· 스윙 지지선 ($0.09): 현재가와 일치, 강력한 단기 지지선 역할
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.09): 현재가와 일치, 돌파 시 추가 상승 기대

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.09) vs SMA5 ($0.09)/SMA20 ($0.08)/SMA50 ($0.08): Above SMA20/50, confirming short-to-mid-term uptrend position.
· SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.09) comparison: Mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained.
· 52-week position (9.3%): Attempting recovery near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (54.8 → 62.8): Exiting oversold, entering neutral zone, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0003 → -0.0002): Improving within negative territory, signaling weakening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position ($0.09): Above the middle band (SMA20 $0.08); band width (30.50%) indicates sustained volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.09): Coincides with current price, acting as strong short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($0.09): Coincides with current price; breakthrough expected to drive further gains.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Attempting recovery after forming a Higher Low): Suggests potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.58x): Above-average volume increases confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Considering entry for buy based on RSI exiting oversold and achieving a 5-day high.
